filePath.description:
full local file paths in the repository, (not url encoded).
e.g
platform/zoo/src/main/c3/zoo/resource/pathsTesting/path with spaces.txt
platform/zoo/src/main/c3/zoo/resource/pathsTesting/path#with#pound#sign.txt
platform/zoo/src/main/c3/zoo/resource/pathsTesting/path+with+plus.txt

renamedFrom.description: full local file path in repository if renamed from this to {@link Git.FileChange#filePath}, (not url encoded)

additions.description: Count of line additions. -1 if file is binary.

deletions.description: Count of line deletions. -1 if file is binary.
